name.en: Exports of goods and services (current US$)
name.zh: 货物与服务出口额（当年美元）

definition.en: Annual exports of goods and services at current prices in US dollars; not a physical freight measure.
definition.zh: 按当年价格及美元计价的年度货物与服务出口额，不代表实物货运量。

coverage.en: Economy-wide national accounts exports of goods and services.
coverage.zh: 经济体国民账户口径的全部货物与服务出口。
